## CORE PRODUCT FACTS

Alibarbar Ingot 9000:

- Rated puff count: up to 9000 puffs
- E-liquid: 22ml pre-filled
- Battery: 2350mAh built-in
- Rechargeable: no
- Coil: mesh
- Activation: inhale-activated
- Display: smart LED showing battery and e-liquid levels
- Net weight: approximately 90g
- Format: sealed disposable device
- Manufacturer-rated figure; actual puff count varies by puff duration and draw style. Not a guaranteed 9000-puff outcome.

## NICOTINE

- Exact nicotine strength is not treated as one fixed site-wide value. Strength can vary by batch and region, so the mg/mL or percentage printed on the packaging for that unit is the source of truth. If packaging conflicts with a website figure, do not assume the website figure is correct.

## CURRENT CATALOGUE PRICES IN CODE

These are catalogue values in the codebase and may change:

- Single flavour device: A$35
- 5 Flavour Custom Pack: A$165
- 10 Flavour Custom Pack: A$300
- 20 Flavour Custom Pack: A$500

Catalogue prices currently list a single Ingot 9000 flavour at A$35, with custom packs at A$165 for 5, A$300 for 10 and A$500 for 20. Confirm live pricing on the product page before relying on these figures.

## SHIPPING VALUES IN CODE

- 1–9 devices: A$15 Regular Post
- 10–19 devices: A$10 Regular Post
- 20+ devices: free Regular Post
- Typical delivery in site content: approximately 3–7 business days after payment confirmation

Catalogue shipping is A$15 for 1–9 devices, A$10 for 10–19 devices, and free Regular Post for 20 or more. Typical delivery is approximately 3–7 business days after payment confirmation. These are site-stated catalogue values and may change.

## AUTHENTICITY

Genuine Ingot 9000 devices should match:

- ALIBARBAR branding
- up to 9000 puffs
- 22ml e-liquid
- 2350mAh battery
- smart LED showing battery and e-liquid levels

Missing or inconsistent specifications are warning signs.

## AUSTRALIAN REGULATORY WARNING

Australian government guidance currently restricts vaping products to pharmacy settings for therapeutic purposes, with additional conditions based on nicotine strength and state or territory law. Catalogue, shipping and checkout information on this site describes the site’s listed range and must not be treated as proof of lawful non-pharmacy supply. Always verify current TGA and local requirements independently. This is general information, not legal advice.

Official source: https://www.tga.gov.au/products/unapproved-therapeutic-goods/vaping-hub
Regulatory facts last reviewed: 2026-08-13
